name: MailAccess
description: High-throughput email OSINT investigation toolkit and domain-level mailbox harvesting engine.
how_to_use: Investigate email addresses across breach databases and social networks to build an identity graph, or harvest all corporate employee emails exposed across a target domain.
command_example:
mailaccess investigate target@example.com
# Or harvest domain emails:
mailaccess harvest-emails --domain target.com

name: TorBot
description: Dark web OSINT crawler, hidden services mapper, and link tree visualizer for the Tor network.
installation: git clone https://github.com/DedSecInside/TorBot.git && cd TorBot && pip install -r requirements.txt
how_to_use: Crawl and map .onion hidden services, verify live uptime of onion endpoints, and generate interactive link-tree graphs illustrating dark web infrastructure dependencies.
command_example:
python torbot -u http://<target-service>.onion --status
# Recursive crawl and save link tree:
python torbot -u http://<target-service>.onion --depth 2 --save json

name: Horus
description: Multi-purpose OSINT and digital forensics assistant for unified artifact investigation and data synthesis.
installation: git clone https://github.com/6abd/horus.git && cd horus && pip install -r requirements.txt
how_to_use: Perform multi-vector OSINT triage, correlate indicators (usernames, domains, hashes), inspect metadata, and decode suspect artifacts via a unified terminal interface.

name: Security News Scraper
description: Automated cybersecurity news aggregator, RSS harvester, and threat advisory scraper.
installation: git clone https://github.com/CarterPerez-dev/Cybersecurity-Projects.git && cd Cybersecurity-Projects/PROJECTS/intermediate/security-news-scraper && go run main.go
how_to_use: Scrape, aggregate, and parse the latest cybersecurity news, vendor zero-day advisories, and extracted CVE identifiers into structured feeds for daily threat monitoring.
command_example:
go run main.go
# Or build binary:
go build -o news-scraper main.go && ./news-scraper

name: Steganography Multi-Tool
description: Forensic image steganography analyzer and hidden payload detection utility.
installation: git clone https://github.com/CarterPerez-dev/Cybersecurity-Projects.git && cd Cybersecurity-Projects/PROJECTS/beginner/steganography-multi-tool && python -m venv venv && pip install -r requirements.txt
how_to_use: Analyze digital image files (PNG, BMP, JPG) for hidden data, perform LSB analysis, and extract concealed textual payloads or embedded binary streams.
command_example:
python main.py --decode --image evidence.png
# Encode message:
python main.py --encode --image cover.png --output stego.png --message "Secret"

name: Scapy
description: Powerful interactive packet manipulation library and network reconnaissance engine.
how_to_use: Craft custom packet probes (TCP/UDP/ICMP), perform low-level network tracerouting, audit firewall rule boundaries, or sniff and dissect live interface frames.
command_example:
scapy
# Example SYN probe:
>>> sr1(IP(dst="192.168.1.1")/TCP(dport=80, flags="S"), timeout=2)

name: Sniffnet
description: Cross-platform application to monitor and analyze Internet network traffic comfortably and multilingually.
how_to_use: Monitor live network traffic through a cross-platform GUI to analyze connection bandwidth, track peer IP countries, and inspect communicating Autonomous Systems (ASNs).

name: Rveng
description: Advanced binary analysis and reverse engineering framework for executable inspection and disassembly.
installation: git clone https://github.com/CarterPerez-dev/Cybersecurity-Projects.git && cd Cybersecurity-Projects/PROJECTS/advanced/rveng && pip install -r requirements.txt
how_to_use: Disassemble compiled PE/ELF binaries, analyze import tables and headers, and harvest hardcoded C2 addresses and configuration strings offline during sample triage.
command_example:
python main.py --file target_sample.bin --disassemble
# Inspect headers:
python main.py --file target_sample.exe --headers

name: Containerlab
description: Declarative container-based network lab orchestration system for simulating complex network topologies.
how_to_use: Deploy and manage containerized networking labs (Nokia, Cisco, Arista routers) from declarative YAML files to simulate target enterprise network topologies in Docker.
command_example:
sudo containerlab deploy --topo topology.clab.yml
# Inspect running topology:
sudo containerlab inspect --all

name: System Design 101
description: Comprehensive visual reference and deep-dive compendium for system architecture and large-scale infrastructure design.
how_to_use: Study visual architectural blueprints of distributed systems (load balancers, CDN edge caching, reverse proxies, and microservices) to model and analyze enterprise attack surfaces.

name: Awesome Networking (Facyber)
description: Curated list of essential computer networking resources, protocols, packet analysis tools, and RFCs.
how_to_use: Consult curated reference guides covering protocol specifications (TCP/IP, BGP, OSPF), RFC standards, packet structure, and network troubleshooting utilities.

name: Awesome Networking (Nyquist)
description: Curated index of modern network engineering tools, libraries, BGP frameworks, and performance analyzers.
how_to_use: Reference modern network engineering libraries, kernel-bypass capture frameworks, and routing daemons when researching large-scale internet topology and BGP routing.

name: Multiplayer Networking Resources
description: Comprehensive technical index of real-time UDP network protocols, state synchronization, and packet architectures.
how_to_use: Analyze low-level UDP socket communication, state synchronization algorithms, and packet serialization when reverse-engineering custom network protocols.
